_comment: Two-floor sheet: FLOOR 2 on top, FLOOR 1 with an attached garage below. Wall faces measured from the image with scripts/tmp profiling (row/column ink runs); px/ft derived from the PRIMARY BEDROOM's 12'7" x 13'3" interior (196px / 12.583ft, 207px / 13.25ft). The garage is non-GLA and excluded geometrically, so FLOOR 1 stops at the house's right wall and FLOOR 2 becomes the largest floor. KITCHEN is open-plan toward the dining area (no physical wall on that side) so it is unscored; the app flags such labels with reduced confidence instead.

scale.provenance: Median of the 12 axes implied by the six ink-measured room rects below (15.42-15.97 px/ft, 3.6% spread). Those rects are interior wall faces: PRIMARY BEDROOM's left wall ink is x=410-415 and its right wall x=612-619, giving faces 416 and 611 against the stored rect [417, 611]. The header pixelsPerFoot 15.6 above is the same PRIMARY BEDROOM read taken face-to-face inclusive (196px/12.583ft, 207px/13.25ft) and is left alone because the outerAreaSqFt/innerAreaSqFt checks are scored through it. floorplan-image.test.js's PPF = 16.0 is a loose sanity constant for sq-ft bands, not a third truth claim.
